unauthorized: Your session expired. Please log in again.
permissionDenied: You do not have permission to do that.
knownColumnsTitle: Failed to load row details from distributed or merge table
knownColumnsWithList: To show every field for a row, {{brand}} loads the full row using the Known Columns List configured on this source (instead of a SELECT * query). This likely failed because the list references a column that doesn't exist in every target table of the Distributed or Merge table. Update the Known Columns List so it only includes columns present in all target tables.
knownColumnsWithoutList: To show every field for this row, {{brand}} loads the full row with a SELECT * query. This failed because a column declared by the parent (distributed) table is missing from at least one target table. To fix this, set a Known Columns List on this source, specifying a list of columns that every target table has. When set, {{brand}} will select those columns instead of SELECT *.
materializedColumnsTitle: Materialized and alias columns are on
materializedColumnsBody: The row query includes MATERIALIZED and ALIAS columns. The whole row fails to load if the connection's user cannot change query settings (for example, a readonly user) or if one of these columns cannot be evaluated.
